html: נמר (√ of foll., meaning dub.; poss. cp. Assyrian namâru, shine, gleam (from glossy coat of panther and leopard), [v. Arabic نَمِرٌ pardus, and limpidus, purus (of water; cf. infr. נמרים)] so HomNS 294 f.; ag. this NöZMG xl (1886), 736 SchwallyIdiot. 121; נָמֵר is comm. Sem.: Assyrian nimru DlHWB 468; Arabic نَمِرٌ, نِمْرٌ Lane2853; Ethiopic ነምር Syriac ܢܶܡܪܳܐ, 𝔗 נִמְרָא; NH נָמֵר).
